risks.risk: Missing/failed drilling consumables or worn drill head/bit (can be expensive to replace).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drill head/bit and any wear parts, plus a photo of the bit size/spec label if present.

risks.risk: Hydraulic leaks or hose/pipe damage not visible from wide shots.
risks.proof: Video/pictures of hydraulic lines and joints while operating (look for leaks), plus a close-up of hose connections.

risks.risk: Truck chassis condition (gearbox/clutch, brakes, tires, suspension) affects total value.
risks.proof: Photos of tires tread, brake area, undercarriage, and a short drive video (slow drive + brake test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: chassis condition not guaranteed (assume service/repairs needed).

Close-up photos of the drill head/bit and any wear parts (with readable labels/specs).
Photos/video of hydraulic hoses and joints while running to confirm no leaks.
Clear photos of truck VIN/plate and rig nameplate/serial/model (no watermark).
Drive/road test video (slow drive + brake test) and photos of tires/suspension.
